For X1 Series: Bambu Lab Wiki

strings.en: The chamber temperature regulator fan is used to control the temperature and to help filter air inside the chassis.

The cooling fan is used for cooling and reducing the temperature of the ceramic heater for hotend. In addition, the cooling fan for our hotend has an auto-shutoff after being locked at rated voltage for 1-3 seconds. The circuit attempts to restart in 2 to 6 seconds. There is no damage after 72 hours of locking.
Learn more about the replacement of cooling fan for hotend for X1 Series on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Cooling Fan for Hotend - X1 Series
The thermistor has highly accurate temperature measurement and reliable structural design, which is for use with Bambu nozzle assemblies only.
Learn more about the replacement of thermistor on Bambu Lab Wiki.
The ceramic heater can heat the nozzle up to 300℃, which is for use with Bambu nozzle assemblies only.
Learn more about the replacement of ceramic heater on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Bambu bus cable is only suitable for use with Bambu Lab X1 series printers. Compatibility: X1 Series, P1P

The Bambu Lab USB-C cable is installed in the towing chain and is only suitable for Bambu Lab X1 series printers. Compatibility: X1 Series Exclusive Bambu USB-C Cable Technical Specifications Materials Plastic, metal Package Weight 30 g Package Size 200*145*4 mm Color Black
Learn more about the replacement of the USB-C Cable on Bambu Lab Wiki.
The Nozzle Wiper is used to clean up the waste overflowing from the nozzle of the printer. It consists of PP elastic structure, PTFE tube, and a lock screw.
Learn more about the replacement of nozzle wiper on Bambu Lab Wiki.

Prolonging the lifetime of the build plate is to use a sharp scraper for releasing the model from the printing surface. After the plate has cooled down, gently slide the scraper underneath one of the corners of the model. Then, carefully bend the sheet to remove the model.
How to print your Scraper grip?
Bambu Lab 3D printer comes with scraper models. Print 'Scraper grip' from the built-in files! Here is the STL Model！

Melt extrusion printers will generate VOCs while printing because the heating temperature of ABS, PC, PA and other materials is relatively high, resulting in more VOCs. Materials such as PLA with lower melting points produce much fewer VOCs during printing.

strings.en: The Bambu Hardened Steel Extruder Unit is driven by hardened steel double gears to increase extrusion force, to prevent slippage and to be more abrasion resistant.It's not only suitable for common 3D printing filaments but also for engineering filaments like carbon fiber nylon, glass fiber nylon, etc. It also supports the filament break detection.
Learn more about the replacement of hardened steel extruder unit for X1 Series on Bambu Lab Wiki.

Bambu Lab AMS Driven Support Shaft Assembly is a roller for supporting the filament spool.
Bambu Lab AMS Active Support Shaft Assembly is a roller for supporting the filament spool and also for actively driving the spool to roll.
Learn more about the replacement of active support shaft on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Bambu Lab AMS Active Extrusion Wheel Assembly is a friction wheel assembly for actively driving the filament forward.
Learn more about the replacement of extrusion wheel on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The purpose of the front glass door is to keep the inside of the printer closed, thus providing protection for the printing process while also insulating the enclosure for high-temperature printing. Compatibility: X1 Series Exclusive

The P1S and X1C use the same specification for the front glass door. If you want to install a front glass door on P1P, you need to install the front door mounting kit and replace the front cover of the P1S (filling the gap) at the same time.
